items.title: You gave your AI agent access, but who is giving it orders?
items.snippet: AI agents can be manipulated through malicious emails, websites, and plugins into executing commands, stealing data, or deleting files using their legitimate permissions. Gen Digital explains how its Agent Trust Hub helps protect agents through skill verification, secure connectivity, and runtime controls that intercep
items.summary: Gen Digital says malicious emails, websites, and plugins can manipulate AI agents into executing commands, stealing data, or deleting files using their legitimate permissions.
items.why: Verify agent skills and restrict permissions; review what emails, websites, and plugins can instruct agents to do.

items.title: UK proposes 14-year prison terms for undersea cable sabotage
items.snippet: In an era of hybrid threats, the British government wants to update the Submarine Telegraph Act 1885, which carries a maximum fine of £1,000 and five years’ imprisonment in cases of deliberate damage.
items.summary: The British government proposes updating a law on deliberate undersea cable damage, which currently carries a maximum fine of £1,000 and five years’ imprisonment.
items.why: Undersea cables are critical infrastructure; consider their security and resilience in risk planning.

items.title: Capcom confirms data breach affecting 11.7 million accounts
items.snippet: Japanese gaming giant Capcom has confirmed that hackers breached its membership service, CAPCOM ID, exposing more than 11.7 million customer email addresses and associated information. [...]
items.summary: Capcom confirms hackers breached its CAPCOM ID membership service, exposing customer email addresses and associated information.
items.why: Review account data exposure and notify affected users through established incident-response processes.

items.title: HPE patches eight max severity RCE and auth bypass AOS flaws
items.snippet: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) released security updates to patch 72 vulnerabilities in the Aruba Operating System (ArubaOS), including eight maximum-severity authentication bypass and code execution issues. [...]
items.summary: HPE released updates for 72 ArubaOS vulnerabilities, including eight maximum-severity authentication bypass and code execution issues.
items.why: Check ArubaOS versions and apply HPE’s security updates to address authentication bypass and code execution flaws.

items.title: Quest Diagnostics warns of potential data theft after attack on lab service system
items.snippet: Nationwide lab test company Quest Diagnostics said one of its key systems may have experienced a breach of patient data.
items.summary: Quest Diagnostics said one of its key systems may have experienced a breach of patient data.
items.why: Review exposure of patient data and monitor relevant systems for signs of unauthorized access.

items.title: Arista patches new VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day exploited in attacks
items.snippet: Arista Networks released security updates to patch an actively exploited zero-day vulnerability affecting VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) On-Prem deployments. [...]
items.summary: Arista released updates for an actively exploited zero-day vulnerability affecting VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem deployments.
items.why: Check for affected On-Prem deployments and apply the security updates.

items.title: In Other News: Tor Exit Relays Hijacked, Banks Spot Rogue AI Agents, Self-Rebuilding macOS Ransomware
items.snippet: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Russia’s APT28 hit NATO defense firms, PingCAP source code stolen, ShinyHunters negotiator probe. The post In Other News: Tor Exit Relays Hijacked, Banks Spot Rogue AI Agents, Self-Rebuilding macOS Ransomware appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.summary: SecurityWeek highlights reports about hijacked Tor exit relays, banks spotting rogue AI agents, and other security stories.
items.why: Review how AI agents are monitored and controlled, given reports of rogue agents at banks.

items.title: Hackers Breach Enterprise Firewalls and VPNs, Exposing Over 70,000 Credentials
items.snippet: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a large-scale campaign that has targeted exposed network edge devices such as Fortinet FortiGate and Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect firewalls. "Artifacts from this investigation also indicate that operators in this campaign have obtained access to numerous organizat
items.summary: Researchers disclosed a campaign targeting exposed network-edge devices, including Fortinet FortiGate and Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect firewalls.
items.why: Inventory exposed firewalls and VPNs, and check them for signs of compromise.

items.title: Mirai Botnet Operators Join PHP2Shell Attacks as ASLR Bypass Exploits Emerge
items.snippet: Researchers tie PHP2Shell attempts to a Mirai botnet and show an ASLR bypass, but no successful compromise has been confirmed yet. The post Mirai Botnet Operators Join PHP2Shell Attacks as ASLR Bypass Exploits Emerge appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.summary: Researchers tie PHP2Shell attempts to a Mirai botnet and report an ASLR bypass; no successful compromise has been confirmed.
items.why: Check PHP systems for exposure to PHP2Shell attempts and follow available security guidance.

items.title: PHP Warns of Another Unpatched RCE Two Days After Emergency PHP2Shell Patches
items.snippet: PHP has warned of another way an attacker could run code on a web server, two days after it shipped emergency fixes for the critical PHP2Shell flaws. The new issue, assigned CVE-2026-115560, affects only web applications configured in an unusual way, and PHP considers it an unlikely risk.The project is not issuing an e
items.summary: PHP warns of another potential remote code execution issue after emergency PHP2Shell fixes. It says the new issue affects web applications configured in an unusual way.
items.why: Review PHP web application configurations and check for available fixes.

items.title: Natilus secures Air Force contract to develop blended wing body aircraft
items.snippet: “We think now’s the right time” for a blended wing body design to make its debut, Natilus Chief Operating Officer Nolan Giblin told Breaking Defense.
items.summary: Natilus secured an Air Force contract to develop a blended wing body aircraft. Its chief operating officer told Breaking Defense the company thinks it is the right time for the design to debut.
items.why: The contract advances development of a blended wing body aircraft.

items.title: Leonardo, Rheinmetall secure $4 billion contracts with Italian Army, report says
items.snippet: The defense companies secured two contracts with the Italian Army for $4.16 billion for armored vehicles, an Italian financial newspaper reported.
items.summary: An Italian financial newspaper reported that Leonardo and Rheinmetall secured two Italian Army contracts for armored vehicles.
items.why: The contracts concern armored vehicles, a significant area of military procurement.

items.title: Saudi missile plant expansion may produce more powerful missiles, study says
items.snippet: More capable missiles could help Saudi Arabia deter Iranian attacks and make its military more self-reliant, but they risk fueling a regional missile race.
items.summary: A study says an expanded Saudi missile plant may produce more capable missiles, potentially aiding deterrence and military self-reliance while risking a regional missile race.
items.why: Missile production has implications for regional deterrence and the risk of an arms race.

items.title: Kongsberg demonstrates containerised ‘NSM in a box’
items.snippet: Kongsberg has successfully demonstrated a containerised Naval Strike Missile (NSM) transportation and launch system... The post Kongsberg demonstrates containerised ‘NSM in a box’ appeared first on Naval News .
items.summary: Kongsberg demonstrated a containerised transportation and launch system for the Naval Strike Missile.
items.why: The demonstration highlights a containerised approach to transporting and launching a naval missile.

items.title: China’s first aircraft carrier forms ‘evolving pattern’ of voyages in disputed Asian seas
items.snippet: The carrier group’s passages not far from Taiwan, Japan and the Philippines have raised alerts.
items.summary: China’s first aircraft carrier has an evolving pattern of voyages in disputed Asian seas. Passages near Taiwan, Japan and the Philippines have raised alerts.
items.why: The voyages are relevant to regional military activity near disputed areas.

We knew Russian forces were listening in. We did not know whether the position our men
items.summary: The article describes a fake radio call in a command post and examines deception in mass autonomous warfare.
items.why: Deception can shape operations involving autonomous systems and communications.

items.title: Pentagon, Lockheed agree to decade-long F-35 framework deal for hundreds of jets
items.snippet: The tentative agreement, which still needs lawmakers’ blessing, covers production and sustainment over the 10 years.
items.summary: The Pentagon and Lockheed agreed to a tentative F-35 framework covering production and sustainment over the next 10 years; lawmakers must still approve it.
items.why: The framework concerns long-term fighter production and sustainment.

items.title: Deep Space Advanced Radar Capability (DARC)
items.snippet: The Ministry of Defence (MOD) is proposing to redevelop Cawdor Barracks as the UK host site for the DARC radar programme.
items.summary: The UK Ministry of Defence is proposing to redevelop Cawdor Barracks as the UK host site for the DARC radar programme.
items.why: The proposed site links military infrastructure to the DARC radar programme.

items.title: Melania Trump brokers truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster', White House says
items.snippet: Ukraine and Russia have not confirmed the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.
items.summary: The White House says Melania Trump brokered a truce for Russian-occupied Oleshky; Ukraine and Russia have not confirmed it.
items.why: The unconfirmed claim concerns a truce in a Russian-occupied Ukrainian city.

items.title: Two Israeli soldiers killed in attack by suspected Palestinian gunmen in West Bank
items.snippet: The two attackers were shot dead after a gun battle outside Hebron, four days before Israel's general election.
items.summary: The BBC reports that five Israelis were wounded and two suspected Palestinian attackers were killed in a West Bank shooting, amid heightened tensions and days before Israel's general election.
items.why: The incident’s location and timing place it within a period of heightened West Bank tensions.

items.title: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted
items.snippet: Issues remain with the network used by the Ukrainian military, sources say, after repeated denials of a deliberate slowdown.
items.summary: The BBC reports that Trump says Musk restored Ukraine’s access after a Starlink dispute. It says Ukraine relies on Starlink for military uses, while Musk has denied restricting access.
items.why: Ukraine’s reliance on Starlink makes access to the service strategically relevant to its military.

items.title: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC finds
items.snippet: The UN human rights chief Volker Türk says the multiple attacks may amount to war crimes.
items.summary: A BBC investigation finds Sudan's RSF fighters deliberately targeted hospitals. The UN human rights chief says the multiple attacks may amount to war crimes.
items.why: The allegations highlight the strategic and humanitarian significance of attacks on hospitals in Sudan.

items.title: Finland nearing opening of world’s first permanent nuclear waste repository
items.snippet: Facilities are being built in many countries, but Finland is the first to licence its underground storage facility.
items.summary: Finland is nearing the opening of an underground nuclear waste storage facility, the first of its kind to be licensed.
items.why: The facility is a strategic example of licensed, long-term underground nuclear waste storage.

items.title: Hundreds of flights cancelled as Typhoon Champi shuts Taiwan
items.snippet: One person has died after being swept away by waves in Taiwan's Liuqiu island, authorities say.
items.summary: Typhoon Champi shut Taiwan, with hundreds of flights cancelled. Authorities say one person died after being swept away by waves on Liuqiu island.
items.why: The cancellations indicate disruption to air travel across Taiwan during the typhoon.

items.title: Melania Trump ‘secured ceasefire’ in Ukrainian city Oleshky: White House
items.snippet: No confirmation from Russia or Ukraine as White House says 'localised' ceasefire to take effect in Oleshky.
items.summary: The White House says a localised ceasefire will take effect in Oleshky, but Russia and Ukraine have not confirmed it.
items.why: The competing accounts make confirmation of conditions in Oleshky strategically relevant.

items.title: Trump ordered to testify in $10bn BBC lawsuit discovery: What happens now?
items.snippet: Trump could face sanctions, including dismissal of his lawsuit, if he fails to cooperate with questioning.
items.summary: Trump could face sanctions, including dismissal of his lawsuit, if he fails to cooperate with questioning in the BBC lawsuit discovery.
items.why: The case turns on cooperation with questioning during legal discovery.
